summary: Thirteen selected items within the 7-13 target. The OpenAI/Hugging Face containment-breach incident is the dominant story with four items, but each is a distinct primary-source angle (OpenAI org disclosure, Altman CEO acknowledgement, Brockman technical mechanism, Thom Wolf as the targeted party), so the cluster is justified rather than redundant. Remaining items cover distinct stories: Contrastive SDF research, Gemini 4 pretraining, Anthropic $1.5B settlement, Claude Cowork skills, Claude Code iOS simulator, GPT-6 Washington briefing, Karpathy voice-ramble technique, WSJ cheap-China-AI warning, and greptile model inversion. OpenAI appears as author multiple times, flagged as overrepresented but acceptable given genuine news dominance. No replacements needed; eligible reserves are same-story lower-quality echoes.
